protocol.artifactPolicy: Raw local transcripts and private session content are not committed.

results.planning: Sol produced the strongest depth; Terra preserved the required architecture and evidence at materially lower cost.
results.implementation: Terra, Sol, Fable, GPT-5.5, and Gemini Flash passed all five hidden contract checks. GLM-5.2 and Kimi missed null and signed-integer behavior.
results.review: All candidates found the seeded cross-tenant defect and clean controls produced no findings. GPT-5.2 remains the review incumbent because Factory's April 2026 50-PR benchmark reports the highest mean F1.
results.routing: Terra selected the right primary workflow with 3-5 skill calls per case. GLM selected the same primary workflows but loaded 20-43 skills per case.

limitations: Single-run local evidence is sufficient only for provisional assignments.
Droid-targeted runs did not reproduce the exact Task boundary for every role.
Role pins require five-repeat public and held-out evaluation before becoming validated.
